DHTH.Panel.Title: Targets
DHTH.Picker.Title: Choose a Target
DHTH.Picker.HintSingle: No target selected. Choose one to continue.
DHTH.Picker.HintMulti: No target selected. Choose your targets, then confirm.
DHTH.Survey.Title: Distances from {name}
DHTH.Survey.Hint: Everything on this scene and how far away it is. Nothing here is targeted — this is just a look around.
DHTH.Settings.Vfx.Menu.Name: Action Animations
DHTH.Settings.Vfx.Menu.Label: Configure Animations
DHTH.Settings.Vfx.Menu.Hint: When action animations play, and how they sit alongside the damage flash.
DHTH.Settings.Vfx.Enabled.Name: Play action animations
DHTH.Settings.Vfx.Enabled.Hint: Turn every configured action animation on or off at once. The portrait flashes and floating numbers are unaffected.
DHTH.Settings.Vfx.Timing.Name: Play the animation
DHTH.Settings.Vfx.Timing.Hint: On the roll, the swing reads while everyone is still looking at the dice, and the damage flash follows separately. On completion, it plays once the whole action has resolved — including a miss, which is still depicted.
DHTH.Settings.Vfx.ChainFlash.Name: Flash after the animation
DHTH.Settings.Vfx.ChainFlash.Hint: Hold a target's damage flash until its animation has finished, so the two read as one beat instead of landing on top of each other.
DHTH.Settings.Vfx.ChainFlash.Mismatch: With animations timed to the roll there is nothing to wait for — the animation has finished long before damage is applied, so the flash is never actually held.
DHTH.Vfx.Title: Animation — {name}
DHTH.Vfx.Sequence.After: Each waits for the one before
DHTH.Vfx.Notify.Copied: Copied from {name}. Press Save to keep it.
DHTH.Vfx.Notify.CopyFailed: That action has no animation to copy.
DHTH.Vfx.Field.KeyHint: A Sequencer database key, or a full modules/… path. Type three characters or more for suggestions.
DHTH.Vfx.Status.Configured: This action has its own animation.
DHTH.Vfx.Status.Unconfigured: Not configured — this action falls back to name matching.
DHTH.Vfx.Notify.NoActions: That item has no actions to configure.
DHTH.Vfx.Notify.NoPair: A spanning animation needs two portraits on screen to preview.
DHTH.Vfx.Notify.NoPortrait: No portrait on screen to preview on.
DHTH.Notify.NoCandidates: No valid targets available in this scene.
DHTH.Notify.ReplayFailed: Targets were set, but the action could not be re-run. Please trigger it again.
DHTH.Settings.Enabled.Name: Enable Target Helper
DHTH.Settings.Enabled.Hint: Prompt for a target when you use a targeted action with nothing targeted.
DHTH.Settings.PortraitIntegration.Name: Show Target Portraits
DHTH.Settings.PortraitIntegration.Hint: When a targeted action is used, raise the target's portrait in Ginzzzu's Portraits & NPC Dock and animate it. Requires that module; ignored otherwise.
DHTH.Settings.DamageNumbers.Name: Floating Damage Numbers
DHTH.Settings.DamageNumbers.Hint: Float resource changes off a target's portrait as they happen — Hit Points marked, Stress, healing. The system's own scrolling text is drawn over tokens, which are not visible in Theatre of the Mind. Requires Show Target Portraits.
DHTH.Settings.PortraitLinger.Name: Portrait Linger (seconds)
DHTH.Settings.PortraitLinger.Hint: How long a target's portrait stays up after the last damage or healing it received. Portraits you raised by hand are never closed.
DHTH.Settings.PortraitFacing.Name: Turn Portraits To Face The Attacker
DHTH.Settings.PortraitFacing.Hint: Mirror a target's portrait, while it is up, so its subject looks towards whoever is acting on it. Pick the direction your portrait art faces when it is not flipped; an actor whose art faces the other way is fixed by flipping it once with a right-click, which this builds on rather than overrides. Requires Show Target Portraits.
DHTH.Settings.ClearTargets.Name: Clear Targets After Action
DHTH.Settings.ClearTargets.Hint: Release your targets automatically once a targeted action finishes. Damage and healing still apply to the targets already recorded on the chat card.
DHTH.Settings.MissFeedback.Name: Miss Feedback
DHTH.Settings.MissFeedback.Hint: When an attack hits none of its targets, remove the Roll Damage button from the chat card and flash a block/deflect on the target's portrait. Attacks without a target are unaffected.
